svg.title: Apply this to the disjoint union of background and response labels with γ = W + M siteFactor(B)c. Submultiplicativity prices each component by the product of label en- velopes. Restricting to permitted components decreases the sum; grouping by output support and inventory preserves it. This proves the closure price and support-exponent loss above. For the exact identity, expand the field polynomial and Q j(1 + uj) and join intersecting chosen labels. A nonzero response is offits healthy region, so its support meets a flag, which belongs to a chosen background inventory. Its component therefore contains a background factor. Original
